scope: Exploratory inner-only feasibility; no outer-test evaluation, no confirmatory CI, no SOTA claim
RNA: training-local frozen Hallmark-enriched512; measured mask and gene identity retained; linear main effect shared across arms
visual: one frozen CONCHv1.5 backbone; fixed geometry subset of audited512 cache; no RNA ROI selection
main_effect: joint trainable Clinical+S32+LOCAL_CONCH_PCA32+RNA512 linear Cox; convex ridge initialization; common fixed block L2=1; no teacher or stacking
reference: mean of complete C,R,RM input on exact training partition; missingness is part of RNA reference; not a biological counterfactual
selection: minimum inner validation full-risk Efron loss EMA(alpha=.2); same maximum schedule in every neural arm; no outer labels read
primary_endpoint: DSS; other endpoint labels are not used

gate.scope: engineering follow-up decision on overlapping inner partitions; not independent efficacy inference

formal_evaluation: NOT STARTED. Future outer matrix must be preregistered independently; global inner results have selection exposure and cannot validate the chosen architecture on this cohort without disclosure.
compute_matching: common hidden/head/patch/gene/schedule; measured parameter and attention-score counts reported; operators differ in FLOPs, therefore this pilot cannot establish compute-matched superiority
privacy: patient data, predictions, selected genes, permutations and trained weights remain private; only anonymous aggregate tables and code are published
